summary: WARP-0903 (per-account token governor + in-session resume-waiter, W3 of PLAN-0009) is a clean, correct, additive W3. GATE GREEN at e4ff4d2, selftest 1322 passed / 0 failed. The per-account governor is a genuine reuse of the untouched single-pool control law (no deletions, no reimplemented pacing arithmetic); burn is attributed per WARP_ACCOUNT tag; resume is per-account; and the InSessionWaiter is a strictly in-session blocking wait with no detached/spawned path - the governor cannot even import a sleep or spawn primitive.
